cases.source: Investigate exactly this finite mathematical proposition: 8*(t-1) equals 8*t-8 for t in [1,4,7,11]. These are two proposed position formulas. Read this source, register the specified proposition, independently evaluate it and record a decision restricted to those four cases. The finite arithmetic result is not validation of a physical robot.

Investigate exactly this finite mathematical proposition: 3*m+7 equals 7*m for m in [-2,0,3,6]. These are two proposed package mass calculations. Register precisely this equality on the four specified inputs, independently evaluate it, retain any counterexamples and record a scoped decision. Do not replace the requested proposition with a different identity.

Investigate whether a microphone's measured sound pressure level differs from a calibrated reference by less than 1 decibel over a fixed 60-second recording. This workspace has no paired recordings, reference calibration, microphone runner, audio simulator or acoustic evaluator. Only finite rational arithmetic can currently be evaluated. Request a precise missing capability with an observable acceptance test and bounded scope if this empirical task cannot be performed.
